remarks:
Beautifully remodeled 4 bedroom, 1 bath ranch with an incredible Lake Ontario location! Just a short walk to the lake with private beach access, this home is an ideal year-round residence, summer getaway, or exciting Airbnb opportunity. From the moment you step inside, you’ll appreciate the fresh and inviting feel. The stunning new kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring gorgeous two-tone white and gray cabinets, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and a spacious dining area that provides the perfect setting for everyday meals or entertaining guests. The large living room is bright and welcoming, with a sliding glass door that leads directly to the backyard and creates an easy connection between indoor and outdoor living. Four comfortable bedrooms provide plenty of space, while the convenient 1st floor laundry adds to the home's functionality. New vinyl windows throughout, newer LVT flooring and carpeting, and a durable metal roof add to the home's move-in-ready appeal.

Outside, the possibilities continue with an expansive lot. The back deck is ready for summer gatherings and features an outdoor shower. A shed provides additional storage for outdoor equipment, while the fenced side yard offers a great space for pets, play, or relaxing outdoors. The double-wide driveway provides ample off-street parking for residents and guests. With its stylish remodeling, spacious layout, private beach access, and unbeatable proximity to Lake Ontario, this property offers a rare opportunity. Whether you're looking for your own lakeside escape, a fantastic year-round home, or a property with strong short-term rental potential, this one is ready to impress!
